issues.description: Method return type mismatch for PersonService.savePerson: The template repository declares public Person savePerson(Person person) (returns Person), while the solution repository declares public void savePerson(Person person) (returns void). Meanwhile, the solution's PersonResource.createPerson invokes personService.savePerson(person) and expects a Person return value (passing it into ResponseEntity.ok(...)). This inconsistency causes a compilation error in the solution and confuses students about the intended service contract for creating/updating persons.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the PersonService.savePerson signature consistent with how it is used by PersonResource and with the template: change the solution's service method to return a Person (public Person savePerson(Person person)) and return the created or updated Person instance. This preserves the endpoint contract (ResponseEntity.ok(savedPerson)) and resolves the compilation error.
